Record Class ChannelId

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.core.ChannelId
Record Components:
topicId - the topic's identity as assigned by the broker
partition - the partition within that topic
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<ChannelId>
public record ChannelId(UUID topicId, int partition) extends Record implements Comparable<ChannelId>
A channel, named by topic identity rather than topic name.

Names are reusable and identities are not, so a topic deleted and recreated under the same name yields a different ChannelId. Positions carried against the old identity cannot be mistaken for positions in the new log.

Ordering is unsigned over the topic identity, then by partition, which gives the canonical order the wire format encodes in.
